messages:
maria-cs: FYI - AtlasCorp reported that after last night's SCIM bulk sync ~40% of members in 'engineers' group never got the role assignment. They show up in their IdP but not in Redwood. Can we triage? :eyes:

alice-support: ugh, saw that in the ticket. They said group size ~120, but only 72 users were created and the role bindings weren't applied for ~20 of those. Customer is on our dedicated sync job (daily bulk).

dan-platform: did we get any errors in the sync logs? rate limits or 5xx?

maria-cs: initial logs show the SCIM POST returned 200s for the batch create endpoint, but our side's post-create role assignment step reported intermittent `422` for some user ids. log excerpt:```
POST /scim/v2/Groups/bulk
200 OK
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
...
assign_role(user: u_78) -> 422 "role mapping missing"
assign_role(user: u_79) -> success
```

raj-eng: hmm, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 is concerning. Which rate limit header is that? IdP or our internal rate limiter?

evie-sre: that header in the snippet looks like upstream IdP. Our internal logs show we hit internal batching concurrency limit around the same time and queued retries. Could be interleave between batch commit and role assignment process.

alice-support: customer says when they re-triggered a manual reconcile from the console all missing users appeared and roles applied. So it's recoverable by reconciliation. But they want root cause and a short-term fix.

dan-platform: can you paste the reconcile job run id and timestamps? We need to reproduce locally against their dev Org.

maria-cs: run id `reconcile-2026-03-07-02` — they have a dev org we can use with token I requested. Timestamps: 1957651400 - 1957652200 (their nightly window).

raj-eng: quick hypothesis: the bulk sync does a group member create in batches of 50, and then asynchronously calls role assignment per user. If the IdP returns 200 for the group update but rate-limits subsequent lookups, some role-assignment tasks will fail and we don't retry idempotently. If those failures are swallowed, a partial-commit state happens.

evie-sre: agree. We also saw a race when `batch_ack` event arrives before assignment queue has enqueued tasks — the job marks group sync complete and the next reconcile won't see missing users until manual re-run. Need to look at ordering guarantees.

maria-cs: customer provided a handy repro: they ran `curl` to push 3 batches quickly. sample request (redacted):```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Groups/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"groups":[{"externalId":"atlas:engineers","members":[...60 users...]}, ...]}'
```
They then polled `/group/status` and saw `synced: true` but `/groups/atlas:engineers/members` missing ~half.

alice-support: customer is asking for two things: a short-term mitigation (so their next nightly won't break) and a permanent fix.

dan-platform: short-term: throttle the customer's bulk sync by limiting batch concurrency for that org to 1 and increase retry attempts for role-assignment tasks. We can set org-specific flags. I'll add a temporary policy for AtlasCorp to serialize syncs.

raj-eng: implementable quickly: set `org.sync.max_concurrent_batches = 1` and bump `assignment.retry.max_attempts = 5` in platform feature flags. Also add a backoff jitter so we don't thundering herd against IdP. I'll open a rollout PR.

maria-cs: please confirm rollback plan, and I'll notify customer. They want ETA < 4 hours.

dan-platform: PR + feature flag rollout target: 90m. If anything goes sideways we can rollback flag. Rollback plan: flip flag off; existing queued tasks finish with current policy.

raj-eng: for permanent fix, propose two changes: 1) make group create+member enqueue part of a single transactional unit where `batch_ack` is gated on enqueue success; 2) make assignment tasks idempotent via `assignment_idempotency_key` and durable retry queue so failed assignments are retried by reconciler. That will require schema change for task metadata and ordering check. I'll draft design doc.

evie-sre: add observability too — emit `group.sync.partial_commit` metric with the count of expected vs applied members and an alert when >5% mismatch for an org. That will catch this automatically.

alice-support: customer update: they agreed to the temp throttle, appreciate quick fix. Asking for status updates in-thread.

deploy-bot: PR #4821 opened by raj-eng: "scim: serialize batch completion & durable assignment retries" — CI started. :thumbsup:

raj-eng: CI passed for unit tests; integration tests still flaky against IdP simulator. Scheduling manual run against AtlasCorp dev org.

dan-platform: flag rollout done for org id `atlas-123` - concurrency set to 1, retries 5. Monitor metrics.

evie-sre: seeing drop in `500`/`422` assignment errors post-rollout. Partial-commit metric for `atlas-123` falls to 0 after one reconcile.

maria-cs: customer confirms manual reconcile re-run succeeded and nightly run completed with full membership. They asked for timeline for permanent fix.

raj-eng: design doc link (private): https://redwood.internal/docs/scim/partial-commit-design — plan to land in two sprints, deploy to staging next week. I'll include migration steps for idempotency keys.

dan-platform: next steps for CS: schedule follow-up with AtlasCorp for postmortem and offer a one-time credits discount for the support overhead.

alice-support: will draft the email and patch notes. Thanks everyone. :heart:

maria-cs: tagging final closure: mark support ticket resolved after PM confirms permanent fix timeline.

raj-eng: posting final root cause summary: "Root cause: race between bulk group commit ack and async role-assignment enqueue + lack of durable idempotent retries. High concurrent batch bursts from IdP rate-limits caused assignment tasks to fail and not be retried reliably leading to partial member-role state. Mitigation: org-level throttling + increased retries. Permanent fix: transactional batch completion gating + durable idempotent retry queue. Observability added."

alice-support: closed with customer 2026-03-07 09:05 UTC (ticket #22188)."
